description.value:
You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for the duration. Choose the curse's nature when you cast the power: the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws using one ability score you choose; or the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you; or the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or waste its action doing nothing; or your attacks and powers deal the target an extra 1d8 necrotic damage while it remains cursed.

A remove curse power ends this effect early, and this power has no effect on droids or constructs. Cast with a 4th-level slot or higher, the duration becomes concentration, up to 10 minutes; a 5th-level slot or higher extends it to 8 hours without requiring concentration; a 7th-level slot or higher extends it to 24 hours; and a 9th-level slot makes the curse last until dispelled.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 3
